entries.title: Keep the NSA out of WebRTC
entries.author: nullc
entries.current_title: Keep the NSA out of WebRTC
entries.excerpt: The upcoming standard for real time communications on the web, WebRTC, currently makes DTLS mandatory to implement: All communications will be encrypted at all times with ephemerally keyed encryption. With DTLS-SRTP content interception will always be _possible_ to detect (e.g. by comparing session IDs) and when coupled with something like Persona (BrowserID) MITM becomes infesable. entries.guide_zh: 围绕 WebRTC 加密标准，作者呼吁防止通信方案受到国家监控影响。

entries.title: Posting to HN is like exposing yourself to the eye of Mordor
entries.author: dsowers
entries.current_title: Posting to HN is like exposing yourself to the eye of Mordor

entries.title: If you didn't cancel the credit card you used for linode.com, now is the time
entries.author: ibudiallo
entries.current_title: If you didn't cancel the credit card you used for linode.com, now is the time
entries.excerpt: I have been a victim of procrastination. Since linode have been compromised, i promised my self i would cancel the credit card and get a new one. Well I didn't, eventually I just stopped thinking about it. On May 28 checked my card account and I see multiple charges for large amounts. (cash converters, groceries, cheese, and so on).
